card.name: Toll-free phone numbers for reporting
card.fires_on: The digit 8 right after '1-' at the start of a toll-free 1-800 or 1-844 number, and the word Center in 'Poison Control Center' before the number. Seen in adverse-reaction reporting and overdose contact lines.

modes.label: Toll-free number start
modes.description: The 8 that begins an 1-800/1-844 number after the hyphen.
modes.example: contact Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC at 1-<<8>>00-551-7

modes.label: Poison Control Center
modes.description: The word Center just before a poison line number in parentheses.
modes.example: Call the National Poison Control<< Center>> (
